title: Australian Jubilant Pudding
description: A classic Australian dessert with a jubilant twist, featuring marshmallow and pudding flavors.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the jubilant mix, sugar, eggs, and melted marshmallow creme.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the baking powder and salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until well combined.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
